create_marigold_image_processor: create a MarigoldImageProcessor instance with configurable VAE scale factor, normalization, and range check options
preprocess_image_for_marigold: preprocess an input image for Marigold pipelines by loading, normalizing, resizing, and padding to VAE scale factor alignment
visualize_depth_map: visualize depth maps as colored PIL images using a configurable colormap and value range
visualize_surface_normals: visualize surface normal maps as RGB PIL images with optional axis flipping
export_depth_to_16bit_png: export depth maps to 16-bit PNG images with configurable value range normalization
